parts.stem:
Cumin is a spice used to flavour food. Two compounds responsible for its flavour are cuminaldehyde and cuminyl alcohol.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Deduce the number of peaks that would be present in the $^{13}\text{C}$ NMR spectrum of cuminyl alcohol.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
Identify **two** bonds that are responsible for the differences in the infra-red spectra of cuminaldehyde and cuminyl alcohol, and state their absorption ranges.
